main_text.p: palma arbore confuevisse, quum antea ex subere fabricari solerent, videntur fuisse ligneolæ hominum figuræ, quas vocat {a}ApuleiusDe mundo, & cujusmodi memorat {b}HerodotusIn Eutcrpe [?]. cubitales: id est, imagunculæ, quarum capita, oculi manus, alia membra, vel singula, vel universa, nervis aut fidiculis in hanc illámve partem à circulatoribus movebantur. Istiusmodi certè fuerunt quæ {c}GalenusDe usu part. corp.hum. lib.3. cap.ult. appellat εἴδωλα ligneæ. Et εἴδωλα virorum, quæ in Tiberim iacta quotannis à Romanis tradut {d}DionysiusAntiq. Rom.lib.1. Halicarnasseus & {e}PlutarchusCapitulor. Romanor. descript. quæst.32., ostendit {f}MacrobiusSatur. lib.1. cap.7. parva extitisse. Videlicet, quum εἰδω-λον significet omnem formam, significat parvam item formam necessario: ut εἰκὼν, quia notat imaginem quamcunque, propterea & parvam {g}i-maginemMat. 22.20. Cæsaris in denario, & magnam ad ho-norem funeris è {h}ceraDio, hist. Rom. lib.56. fictam designat. Verum Bellarminus, dicens idolum diminutivum esse & significare formam parvam innuit significare formam parvam proprie. Quod liquido apparet, tùm ex instituto, expressò verbis præcedentibus; Probatur ex ipsa vocis proprietate: tùm ex sequente ratione; Est enim proprie idolum imago inanis: tùm ex conclusione & summa probationum: Quoniam ergo idolum propria & primaria significatione designat imaginem inanem. Itaque primum argumentum, e loco Tertulliani, Iesuiticam potiùs technam patefacit, quàm propositionem roborat.

page.notes: Doubtful or damaged readings: "Eutcrpe" (probably Euterpe) and "ligneæ" (the final letter may be Greek alpha); "eadè" and "illámve" (accent and ligature uncertain); "dućtum" was printed with a ct ligature and is given as "ductum"; "Herodian.l. 4." note has no letter in the text; the "§" before "i-maginem" is taken as reference mark g; the note letter for Galenus is read as "c" though the margin mark looks like "e" (checked against the text mark). The Greek "εἰδω-λον", "εἰκὼν" and "εἴδωλα" are read from a small type and may carry printer's accents differently.
